summary: A Healthy Grocery Girl blog post by Megan Roosevelt, RDN, describing how to make an Orange Peel Star Garland as a DIY holiday decoration. The author, who enjoys decorating with her daughter, uses peels from mandarin oranges that would otherwise be composted, cutting them into star shapes with cookie cutters and stringing them on twine for mantels, banisters or Christmas trees. The note includes a materials list, step-by-step instructions, and links to related citrus holiday crafts plus a disclosure that a video was made for the Limoneira YouTube channel.
one_line: A DIY guide by Megan Roosevelt for making holiday star garlands from mandarin orange peels cut with cookie cutters.
key_facts: The Orange Peel Star Garland is a DIY holiday decoration made from orange peels, which the author says would otherwise typically be composted.
The author's daughter is now 4.5 years old and has been an incredible helper in holiday decorating.
The equipment list calls for 2-3 small star shaped cookie cutters, 1 rubber or wood mallet, 1 small nail, and 1 cooking twine.
The ingredients list calls for 5 large Limoneira mandarin oranges.
Instructions say to carefully peel the orange into large sections, remove the top, and score the peel into 4 sections without breaking them.
Stars are cut out using cookie cutters and a mallet.
The author says stars with two holes lay flatter than stars with one hole.
The garland is suggested for a holiday mantel, along a banister, or on a Christmas tree.
Megan Roosevelt, RDN is the Spokesperson for Limoneira.
The video on this page was created for the Limoneira YouTube Channel.
Megan Roosevelt is a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist and the founder and CEO of Healthy Grocery Girl.
The host and producer channel is described as the #1 Family Friendly Dietitian Channel on YouTube with over 6.5 million total views.
Readers are asked to share photos on Instagram tagged @HealthyGroceryGirl.
Related posts linked from the page include Citrus Holiday Mantel Decor, DIY Citrus Gift Tags, and Dried Citrus Rose Bouquet.
